errors.evidence: The figure caption indicates the data is for the Republic of Bulgaria ("Р. България"), not specifically the mining industry. This detail seems to have been incorrectly taken from the title of the paper where the figure appeared, not from the figure itself.

errors.text_span: Останаа Y представляват БВП на един отработен човек на час, изчислени на база на текущите цени от 2015 г.
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly combines the definitions of the two data series (current prices and 2015 prices) into the definition of the Y-axis. The Y-axis itself simply represents the value in "лева/човекочас" (BGN/person-hour). It also contains a typo ("Останаа" instead of "Оста").

errors.text_span: Скалата на оста Y достига до 18.94 от 9.95, с интервали от 1.00.
errors.evidence: The Y-axis scale is from 0 to 20, with labeled intervals of 2. The description incorrectly states the range using data point values (9.95 and 18.94) and an incorrect interval value (1.00).
The final value for the blue line in 2018 is 18.94. The value 16.71 corresponds to the year 2016.
The phrase "стоманообразуващ ръст" (literally "steel-forming growth") is nonsensical, subjective jargon that does not describe the data objectively.

errors.text_span: започва при стойност от 6.4 през 2000 г.
errors.evidence: The orange line starts at a value of 9.95 in 2000. The value 6.4 is a data point for the blue line in the year 2002.

The description fails to mention what the two different lines represent, which is crucial information provided in the legend: "БВП на един отработен човекочас по текущи цени" (GDP per hour worked at current prices) for the blue line and "БВП на един отработен човекочас по цени на 2015 г." (GDP per hour worked at 2015 prices) for the orange line.
